name: Declaração Periódica do IVA (Modelo 7)
legal_reference: Código do IVA, art. 44.º — taxable persons submit the periodic declaration by electronic transmission of data, and the system generates the Nota de Liquidação when tax is due. The form is the Modelo 7, filed on the Portal do Contribuinte of the Administração Geral Tributária, with the annexes of suppliers (and of customers where required) and, outside the e-invoicing regime, the SAF-T (AO) files of invoicing. The pack carries the general-regime part of the form (quadro 9, fields 01 to 37); the boxes of the cash-accounting regime and of withheld tax are carried without a tax code that writes into them. Two printings of the form exist (one with fields 26 and 27 headed «regularizações do imposto cativo», one with them headed «regularizações notificadas pela AGT» and an extra field 30); this pack follows the first.

deadline.legal_reference: Código do IVA, art. 44.º — the declaration is submitted by the last day of the month following the one to which the operations relate, whether or not taxable operations took place; the Modelo 7 itself reads «a submeter até ao último dia de cada mês respeitante às operações realizadas do mês anterior». The tax is paid by the same date through the Nota de Liquidação; some commentaries speak of the last working day, which Ekwo's rule (the last calendar day) does not see.

boxes.name: Transmissões e prestações com liquidação de imposto — base tributável
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 01 — the taxable value of the supplies of goods and services on which tax was charged, whatever the rate (14 %, 7 %, 5 % or 1 %); the form has no line per rate.

boxes.name: Transmissões e prestações com liquidação de imposto — imposto a favor do Estado
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 02 — the tax charged on the supplies of field 01.

boxes.name: Regime de IVA de caixa — base tributável
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 03 — the supplies covered by the cash-accounting regime (Código do IVA, art. 60.º). Not posted by any code of this pack.

boxes.name: Regime de IVA de caixa — imposto a favor do Estado
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 04 — the tax on the supplies of field 03. Not posted by any code of this pack.

boxes.name: IVA cativo pelo declarante — base tributável
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 05 — operations in which the declarant withheld the tax (art. 21.º). Not posted by any code of this pack.

boxes.name: IVA cativo pelo declarante — imposto a favor do sujeito passivo
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 06 — the withheld tax deductible by the declarant. Not posted.

boxes.name: IVA cativo pelo declarante — imposto a favor do Estado
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 07 — the withheld tax owed to the State. Not posted.

boxes.name: IVA cativo pelo cliente — base tributável
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 08 — operations in which the customer withheld the tax (art. 31.º). Not posted.

boxes.name: IVA cativo pelo cliente — imposto a favor do sujeito passivo
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 09 — the tax withheld by the customer, in favour of the taxpayer. Not posted.

boxes.name: Isentas com direito à dedução (exportações)
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 10 — supplies on which no tax was charged, exempt with the right to deduct — exports, whose detail is field 45.

boxes.name: Isentas sem direito à dedução
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 11 — exempt supplies without the right to deduct (art. 12.º, sub-paragraph a excluded).

boxes.name: Não tributadas
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 12 — non-taxed operations (art. 10.º).

boxes.name: Serviços adquiridos a prestador não residente (art. 29.º) — base tributável
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 13 — services bought from a provider with no seat, permanent establishment or domicile in Angola, the tax being charged by the declarant.

boxes.name: Serviços adquiridos a prestador não residente — imposto a favor do sujeito passivo
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 14 — the self-charged tax deductible by the declarant.

boxes.name: Serviços adquiridos a prestador não residente — imposto a favor do Estado
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 15 — the tax charged by the declarant on the services of field 13.

boxes.name: Meios fixos e investimentos — base
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 16 — acquisitions of fixed assets and investments, tax-exclusive.

boxes.name: Meios fixos e investimentos — imposto dedutível
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 17 — the deductible tax on the acquisitions of field 16.

boxes.name: Existências — base
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 18 — acquisitions of inventories, tax-exclusive.

boxes.name: Existências — imposto dedutível
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 19 — the deductible tax on the acquisitions of field 18.

boxes.name: Outros bens de consumo — base
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 20 — acquisitions of other consumable goods, tax-exclusive.

boxes.name: Outros bens de consumo — imposto dedutível
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 21 — the deductible tax on the acquisitions of field 20.

boxes.name: Serviços — base
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 22 — acquisitions of services, tax-exclusive.

boxes.name: Serviços — imposto dedutível
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 23 — the deductible tax on the acquisitions of field 22.

boxes.name: Importações de bens — base
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 24 — imports of goods, at customs value.

boxes.name: Importações de bens — imposto dedutível
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 25 — the deductible tax paid on imports.

boxes.name: Regularizações do imposto cativo — a favor do sujeito passivo
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 26 — adjustments of withheld tax in favour of the taxpayer. Not posted.

boxes.name: Regularizações do imposto cativo — a favor do Estado
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 27 — adjustments of withheld tax in favour of the State. Not posted.

boxes.name: Regularizações mensais ou anuais — a favor do sujeito passivo
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 28 — monthly or annual adjustments made by the taxpayer, in its favour. Not posted.

boxes.name: Regularizações mensais ou anuais — a favor do Estado
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 29 — monthly or annual adjustments made by the taxpayer, in favour of the State. Not posted.

boxes.name: Soma das bases tributáveis
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 31 — the sum of fields 1+3+5+8+10+11+12+13+16+18+20+22+24.

boxes.name: Soma do imposto a favor do sujeito passivo
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 32 — the sum of fields 6+9+14+17+19+21+23+25+26+28.

boxes.name: Soma do imposto a favor do Estado
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 33 — the sum of fields 2+4+7+15+27+29.

boxes.name: Imposto a recuperar
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 34 — field 32 minus field 33 when field 32 is the greater: the credit of the period, carried forward or claimed as a refund (art. 26.º).

boxes.name: Imposto a pagar do período
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 35 — field 33 minus field 32 when field 33 is the greater.

boxes.name: IVA a pagar ao Estado
boxes.legal_reference: Modelo 7, quadro 9, field 37 — field 35 minus field 36, the use of credits of earlier periods. Field 36 is a taxpayer input that this pack does not carry, so field 37 equals field 35; the system issues the Nota de Liquidação (art. 44.º).
